Title: Aditya's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Aditya - 12 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Isha - 12 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
3. Shalini - 39 years, mother
Look: green saree
4. Sharda - 66 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it
4. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Aditya stands in the living room. Shalini and Sharda stand near him.]

Shalini: "What lovely weather!"

[Aditya sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Sharda (gently): "And then?"

[Aditya mops the floor.]

Shalini: "Mother, listen!"

[Aditya irons his school shirt.]

Aditya: "Oh wow!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Shalini and Isha stand near him.]

Shalini: "So, here we are!"

[Aditya climbs the stairs to the terrace.]

Aditya: "Yes, of course."

[Aditya dances to the music.]

Aditya: "Really?"

[Aditya carries his school bag on his back.]

Isha: "Exactly right."

[A strong wind starts blowing.]

Aditya: "That's great!"

Scene 3: The road - Day

[Aditya stands by the road. Shalini and Sharda stand near him.]

Sharda: "So, here we are!"

[Aditya rides his bicycle down the road.]

Aditya (softly): "Show me too!"

[Aditya hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Aditya: "That's easy."

Scene 4: The park - Day

Aditya: "What a nice place."

[Aditya does yoga on a mat.]

Aditya: "Yes, all right."

[Isha skips rope.]

Isha: "What a day to remember!"
